events.immediate: { ywc_v03_mark_major_delivered = yes set_variable = { name = ywc_oir_tolls_last_notice_event value = 1025 } }

label.zh: 先保住可通行的本地关段
label.en: Retain a passable local checkpoint section

cost_note.zh: 不额外收费，不更换所选路线；原先没有拨款的旧例方案仍不收费。
cost_note.en: No added fee or route change; a customary option with no opening grant remains free.

consequence_note.zh: 改按可通行的本地关段核验，重新连续观察六个月；旧观察作废，不能据此取得完整结局。
consequence_note.en: Review a passable local checkpoint section for a fresh six consecutive months; discard the old watch and do not award a full result.

cost_note.zh: 不收费；以受挫结算，不冒充完成。
cost_note.en: No fee; close as a setback, not completion.

consequence_note.zh: 如实记录商路关税议约受挫，结束本项义务；不取得达标结局，原经费不退。
consequence_note.en: Record the setback to the customs compact and end this obligation without a successful result or refund.

options.effect: { set_variable = { name = ywc_oir_tolls_withdrawn value = 1 } ywc_oir_close_tolls_as_breach = yes }

cost_note.zh: 不收费；按撤回结算并释放名额。
cost_note.en: No fee; withdrawal closes the arc and releases its slot.

consequence_note.zh: 撤回商路关税议约，按未能执行结束后续核验；已支出的经费不退。
consequence_note.en: Withdraw the customs compact as an unfulfilled obligation and end further review; money already spent is not refunded.

label.zh: 保留受阻状态，暂不结案
label.en: Keep the blockage open for now

cost_note.zh: 不收费；所选路线、约定范围与既有支出暂不变。
cost_note.en: No fee; keep the selected route, agreed scope and existing expenditure unchanged.

consequence_note.zh: 保留现有方案与既有支出，暂不对商路关税议约作新的承诺或结案。
consequence_note.en: Keep the selected plan and existing expenditure; make no new commitment or final decision on the customs compact.

purpose.zh: 受阻通知只处理资格障碍，不取代正常实施节点。
purpose.en: The notice addresses eligibility without replacing the normal implementation stage.
